## Description

"A speaker system developed by Ferrograph Ltd. of the United Kingdom, which has announced many products as a specialized manufacturer of tape recorders.An elliptical plastic cone woofer unit is mounted in the low range.The middle area is equipped with a 12cm cone type squaker with a plastic edge and an effective diameter of approximately 10cm.A dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The three speaker units are incorporated into a ducted-port enclosure, which consists of a baffle board with cutouts in the corners and partitions to form a long duct, and are wrapped in sound absorbing material inside the enclosure.The enclosure is constructed from a rigid chipboard, to which stands with casters are attached for optimum listening position."
specifications: "Method: 3-Way, 3-Speaker, Bass Reflex System, Floor Type | Units Used: Low Band : EllipseFor Medium Range : 12cm cone typeFor High Frequency : Dome Type | Frequency characteristic: 45Hz to 20kHz | Input impedance: 8� | Allowable input: 100W | Crossover frequency: 400Hz, 3.5kHz | Finish: Lacquer, walnut | External dimensions: Width 350x Height 640x Depth 440mm"
